name: ScyllaHide
purpose: Anti-anti-debug: hides the debugger from IsDebuggerPresent/PEB/timing checks. Essential for unpacking.

name: xAnalyzer
purpose: Extended static analysis: resolves API call arguments, adds comments. VERIFY the current release repo before relying on it.

name: SwissArmyKnife
purpose: Assorted RE utilities by mrfearless. Set 'repo' to the real release repo and enabled:true to install.

name: OllyDumpEx
purpose: Process/module dumping. NOT distributed via GitHub releases — install manually into the plugins dir.

name: Labelless
purpose: Sync labels/comments with IDA. Confirm a fork that ships x64dbg .dp32/.dp64 assets, then enable.
